title: Kroketky z Drůbežích Zbytků (Chicken Croquettes)
description: Prepared with meat, onion, and bread crumbs.

ingredients.name: 2 cups meat from poultry leftovers, finely chopped
hot fat (half butter and half lard)

steps: Chop finely two cups of meat from poultry leftovers
Rub one spoon of butter with two spoons of flour, mix it into two cups of hot milk and cook with constant stirring until it thickens into a thick sauce, being careful it does not burn

Mix everything well into the meat, add the sauce to the meat and mix well again and let cool

title: Kvasová polévka (Bread Sponge Soup)
description: A soup made with rye flour, onion, and sour cream.
steps: Have a special stone pot for fermenting ready.

title: Kyselé Zelí (Sauerkraut)
description: Prepared with cabbage, caraway seeds, and seeds.
steps: Peel and clean the cabbage heads, cut them into quarters and remove the cores
Shred the cabbage on a grater and salt it in a large barrel or on a clean cloth spread on the floor
For fifty large heads, take one and a half pounds of salt, two tablespoons of cleaned caraway seeds and the same amount of dill seeds, and mix well
Cover the bottom of a clean wooden barrel or large stone crock with clean cabbage leaves

Place a layer of shredded cabbage in it, press it with a wooden mallet, add cabbage again, press again, and repeat until the barrel is full, but never add too large a layer at once or it cannot compress well
Place cabbage leaves on the surface, cover the barrel with a clean white cloth, place a well-fitting lid on it and put a clean washed heavy stone on top
Set the barrel in a warm place and let it stand about eight days until it sours
Then store it in a cold place protected from frost and cover with a clean cloth moistened in cold water, which should be washed and replaced after each use
From time to time you must clean the lid, cloth and stone thoroughly so the cabbage does not spoil
If the cabbage dries too much, you must add fresh water
When taking cabbage for cooking, scrape it from the surface with your fingers so the cabbage stays completely flat and cover and weight it again
Some places also add fennel, ground mustard, crushed pepper or juniper to the salt
Between individual layers you can also place peeled and cut sour apples without seeds, which gives the cabbage a particularly good flavor
If you layer the cabbage in a barrel with white wine, it will also acquire a very delicate flavor
Do not oversalt it, as oversalted cabbage will not sour for a long time
It is always better to use several smaller barrels than one large one, and if you want to use the cabbage soon, layer it in stone crocks and set it in a warm place so fermentation begins quickly

Many experienced housewives put shredded cabbage in a barrel, salt it, add caraway and then squeeze it with their hands for a long time until it releases water, then store it in a barrel and squeeze it quickly by hand; cabbage prepared this way lasts the longest

title: Máselné Rohlíčky (Butter Rolls)
description: A bread preparation made with butter, yeast, and egg yolks.

ingredients.name: flour to make a firm dough like for a roll

steps: Let a piece of fresh yeast soak in 1 cup of milk and make a thin batter and let it rise.
When the batter is risen, beat 1 whole egg and 2 egg yolks and add to the batter.
Then rub ½ cup of butter with 2 tablespoons of sugar, add to the batter, mix everything well with a fork and add a little salt.

Add enough flour to make a firm dough like for a roll, roll it out, put it in a warm place to rise, then roll it again and make rolls this way: Roll out the dough to finger thickness, cut it into small pieces with a small glass or round cutter, roll each piece with a rolling pin into a long shape about 6 or 8 inches long and then roll it up.
Hold one end, twist the other end and roll it with your hand, then press the end down with tongs.
When placing on a baking sheet, bend each into a roll shape, grease with warmed butter and let rise well.
When well risen, brush the top with beaten egg and put into a nicely warm oven to bake nicely.

title: Nadivaný pečený kapr (Stuffed Baked Carp)
description: Prepared with carp, lemon juice, and bread or milk.

ingredients.name: bread or roll soaked in milk

steps: Clean the carp well, remove gall and intestines from the roe.
Place roe in a pot, pour well water and lemon juice on it, let it simmer for about five minutes, then remove.

Beat four tablespoons of butter, add one roll soaked and squeezed out in milk or two slices of bread, two beaten eggs, chopped boiled roe, six egg yolks, a bit of ground flower and some ground pepper, salt everything and mix well.
Fill the cleaned and salted carp with this mixture and sew it shut.
Grease a baking pan well with butter, place onion sliced into rounds, lay the salted carp on it, place pieces of fresh butter on it.
Bake and toward the end sprinkle with cleaned and finely chopped anchovies and bake until golden.
Frequently baste the carp with its baked juices during baking.
If desired, you can use anchovy butter instead of ordinary butter in the stuffing, and cook finely chopped mushrooms or truffles in butter instead.

description: Prepared with squabs, bread, and butter.
steps: Cut off the heads of well-cleaned, plucked and rinsed squabs

Rub butter, beat one egg and one yolk into it
Add two spoonfuls of milk, a pinch of salt, a little finely chopped lemon zest, a little chopped fresh parsley, and four spoonfuls of grated bread roll
Mix everything well
Stuff the squabs with this mixture
Tie the giblets shut with thread
Tie the legs to the tail ends
Place the squabs on a baking sheet on a piece of butter
Add a little water and roast them with frequent basting with the roasted juices until nicely done
Cut them into quarters, arrange nicely on a dish and pour the roasted juices over them

title: Nadívané buchtičky (Stuffed Cakes)
description: A cake made with egg yolks or eggs, yeast, and cream or milk.

ingredients.name: one cupful of melted cooled butter
one small cupful of fine sugar
four egg yolks or two whole eggs
a piece of finely cut lemon zest
curd cheese, poppy seed, fruit preserves, sugar with cinnamon, fruit or jam for filling

steps: Sift two quarts of dry flour onto a board, make a hollow in the middle, pour into it one cupful of melted cooled butter, add one small cupful of fine sugar, four egg yolks or two whole eggs, a little pounded flower, a piece of finely cut lemon zest, a little salt, a piece of pressed yeast dissolved with as much lukewarm cream or milk to make a loose dough.

Work it well until the dough no longer sticks to the spoon, let it rise in a warm place, then cut small pieces from it, roll them out, fill with either curd cheese, poppy seed, fruit preserves, sugar with cinnamon, fruit or jam, wrap them, place one next to the other in a buttered pan, let them rise a little more and then bake in the oven.

title: Nadívané jehněčí neb kůzlečí hrudí (Stuffed Lamb or Kid Breast)
description: Prepared with lamb, bread, and egg yolk.
steps: Clean and wash the breast, salt it.
If breast is small, take one loaf, otherwise 2 loaves of bread, grate them, press through a sieve, dry on the stove and crush.
Beat 30 grams of butter, 2 eggs, 1 yolk, a little salt, a little herbs.
Add grated bread to everything.
If the stuffing is too thick, add milk or an egg; the stuffing should be the consistency of porridge.
Fill the cleaned breast with the stuffing using a syringe or spoon and sew it shut.
Add 2 large spoonfuls of water and 30 grams of butter to the breast and bake until reddened.
Cut into neat pieces and serve.

Mix well and fill the kohlrabi
